rootCause: Cliente360 list gate required authoritative server confirmation of both clientes and the full polizas collection before first paint. The list itself only needs clientes; policy-derived fields were incorrectly coupled to the primary list readiness.
fix: Primary Cliente360 list readiness now depends only on authoritative clientes.
Polizas is prefetched but becomes a progressive secondary dependency.
Until polizas is authoritative, policy count, active-policy KPI, net premium, renewals and row policy metrics render explicit Actualizando states instead of false zeros.
Canonical financial/health summary activates only after both policy and portfolio readiness are confirmed.
